name: game-start
description: > Sets up a game project for GameForge: detects engine and project state, writes .gameforge/project.json and session state, merges the engine starter CLAUDE.md, configures Git and Git LFS, and connects coding agents to the engine (MCP, llms.txt). Use for "start a new game", "set up my project", "initialize GameForge". Not for finding an idea (use game-brainstorm).
author: AlterLab-IEU
